gaps.sentence: She spoke with great ___ (WISE) about the risks.
The charity relies entirely on voluntary ___ (DONATE).
gaps.explanation: 'Voluntary donations' — gifts of money given willingly.

gaps.sentence: She was ___ (ABLE) to attend because of illness.
gaps.explanation: 'Unable to attend' — negative of able is unable.

gaps.sentence: The mountain road has been ___ (WIDE) to cope with coach traffic.
gaps.explanation: Passive 'has been widened' — the verb form meaning made wider.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (ARRIVE) of the delegation was delayed by the storm.
The document is of great ___ (IMPORTANT) to the case.
The dogs’ astonishing ___ (LOYAL) to their owners is well documented.
gaps.explanation: 'Astonishing loyalty' — the quality noun is required after the adjective.

gaps.sentence: Send your ___ (APPLY) to the address below.
gaps.explanation: 'Your application' — the document you send; an applicant is a person.
